[[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] {{Name|Shadow Shaman|0.2%}}{{Name|Shadow Brute|0.2%}}{{Name|Iridium Bat|0.8%}}{{Name|Purple Slime|0.9%}}{{Name|Iridium Golem|3%, rolled twice}}{{Name|Statue Of Endless Fortune}} |ingredients = {{Name|Iridium Ore|5}}{{Name|Coal|1}} |sellprice = 1000 |quality = false |craftingstation = {{Name|Furnace}} |crafttime = 8h }} An '''Iridium Bar''' is created primarily by smelting 5 {{Name|Iridium Ore|class=inline}} and 1 {{Name|Coal|class=inline}} in a [[Furnace]]. It can also be obtained in a [[#Locations|variety of other ways]]. An Iridium Bar can be [[Shipping|shipped]] or sold to [[Clint]] at the [[Blacksmith]] Shop for {{Price|1000}}, or {{Price|1500}} with the [[Skills#Mining|Blacksmith Profession]]. Iridium Bars can be used for upgrading tools, crafting, building and trading. 3 Iridium Bars are used to re-forge [[Trinkets]]. ==Locations== Aside from smelting Iridium Ore and Coal in a Furnace, Iridium Bars can be found in: * 0.9% chance from Purple Slimes. * 0.2% chance from [[Shadow Shaman]] and [[Shadow Brute]]s. * 0.8% chance from [[Bats|Iridium Bats]]. * 3% chance from [[Iridium Golem]]s on the [[Farm Maps|Wilderness Farm map]] (rolled twice). * 7% chance for 1-5 to be found in [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]]. * 3.6% chance for 2-3 to be found in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|Skull Cavern treasure rooms]]. * 25% chance from the [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] each day it is not a villager's birthday. * Obtained as a prize from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]]. * Sold by the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|1000}}. * Received as a gift from [[Clint]] at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. * 2 are sold by [[Maru]] in her [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|50|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each. ==Tool Upgrades== Iridium Bars are required for the final upgrade of tools. It is an iridium dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the purple dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]]. ==Quests== *The [[Wizard]] requests an Iridium Bar by mail on the 5th of [[Winter]] (year 2) in the [[Quests#Staff of Power|"Staff of Power" Quest]]. The reward is {{Price|5000}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart. *1 Iridium Bar is requested by [[Lava Eel]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 7 to 10. *[[Fish Shop#Willy's Boat|Willy's Boat]] needs 5 Iridium Bars to repair the anchor. ==Trading== *10 Iridium Bars can be traded at the [[Desert Trader]] for the [[Warp Totem: Desert]] recipe. *15 Iridium Bars can be traded at the [[Desert Trader]] for the [[Midnight Beach Bed]]. *30 Iridium Bars can be traded at the [[Desert Trader]] for the [[Midnight Beach Double Bed]]. ==Trivia== *In real life, iridium is a rare silver, brittle metal that can be hazardous in a fine dust and has toxic radioactive isotopes. It is often used to produce hard, durable surfaces for high-precision tools and machine parts. It is the second densest naturally occurring element, just behind osmium, and almost twice as dense as lead. ==References== See FishingRod::openTreasureMenuEndFunction in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.1|Used as a building material to the [[Water Obelisk]] and [[Earth Obelisk]].}} {{History|1.3.27|Used as an ingredient to the [[Wedding Ring]] recipe.}} {{History|1.4|Used as a building material to the [[Desert Obelisk]].
